acceptedImprovements: PDP artifact now records aria/dialog semantics and open/closed trigger states for close button, backdrop and Escape.
Three successive open/close cycles return focus to the trigger and set aria-expanded=false.
Desktop search regression records its two-stage Escape behavior.
Five forward Tab and three backward Tab steps all remain inside the PDP drawer in the sampled segment.
remainingGaps: The five-forward/three-backward sample does not reach either focus-list boundary and therefore does not prove Tab/Shift+Tab wrap containment.
The artifact records no inert state despite R73 explicitly requesting inert cleanup across repeated cycles.

The artifact environment contains only the PDP URL; Batch 47's claim that the updated artifact covers both Homepage and PDP is false. Homepage remains supported by the older R43 independent check, not this artifact.
There is still no actual screen-reader run, named AT/browser pair, transcript, speech log, or result. DOM ARIA fields do not satisfy acceptance criterion 4's screen-reader check.
decision: Keep R26-01 PARTIAL/OPEN. The decisive blocker remains the explicitly required screen-reader check; additionally provide boundary-wrap and inert evidence rather than short interior Tab samples.
